name: CrossFit Uckfield
description: CrossFit Uckfield operates out of The Paleo Gym, running one classic CrossFit class a day with a constantly varied programme that mixes cardio, gymnastics and weightlifting, coached throughout the session. Alongside general CrossFit classes, they run a Junior Hero Academy for kids and CrossFit Teens, Third Age CrossFit for older athletes, and Quiet Classes for anyone who prefers a smaller, lower-sensory environment, plus modified sessions for anyone recovering from injury or illness and personalised nutrition support.
address: Crockstead Farm, Eastbourne Road, Halland, East Sussex, BN8 6PT

name: CrossFit Crowborough
description: CrossFit Crowborough runs group classes that combine gymnastics, weightlifting and conditioning, with coaches teaching the foundational movements and scaling each workout to the athlete's fitness level. The box also supports members competing in the CrossFit Open and in-house competitions, alongside a supportive, all-levels community.
address: Unit 5, Beacon Business Park, Crowborough, East Sussex, TN6 2GD

name: CrossFit Hailsham (FFH)
description: CrossFit FFH (Fortior Fit Hailsham) scales every workout to the athlete, whether they're lifting for the first time, managing an injury, or training at a high level. Alongside CrossFit classes, they offer sports massage, personal training and nutritional guidance, with a community that spans teachers, tradespeople, parents, students and retirees training side by side.
address: 16 Diplocks Way, Hailsham, East Sussex, BN27 3JY

name: CrossFit Burgess Hill (BYS)
description: BYS CrossFit combines mobility and high-intensity training across cardio, gymnastics, powerlifting and Olympic lifting, with dedicated barbell classes focused on the clean & jerk and snatch and gymnastics classes covering everything from pull-ups to handstand walking. It's run as a supportive, inclusive community for all fitness levels.
address: Unit 6 Sovereign Business Park, Albert Drive, Burgess Hill, RH15 9TY

name: CrossFit Haywards Heath
description: CrossFit Haywards Heath runs functional fitness classes with a different constantly-varied workout each day, suitable for all ages and abilities. Alongside general CrossFit classes, they offer dedicated Olympic Weightlifting and Powerlifting sessions focused on building confidence and refining technique, plus a supportive class for mums getting back into fitness that welcomes children along too.
address: Holmsted Farm Business Units, Staplefield Road, Haywards Heath, RH17 5JF

name: CrossFit Tunbridge Wells
description: CrossFit Tunbridge Wells runs coached CrossFit, weightlifting and strength and conditioning classes for all fitness levels, a short walk from Tunbridge Wells station. New members start with a one-to-one beginners' course, and the gym also runs CrossFit Kids, CrossFit Teens and L.I.F.E., a lower-impact class aimed at older adults.
address: 11A Chapman Way, Tunbridge Wells, Kent, TN2 3EF

name: NOMADS Training Club
description: NOMADS Training Club in Crawley Down runs CrossFit, hybrid training and yoga classes, with more than 28 classes a week and plenty of open gym time. It also runs Little & Lifts, a mum-and-baby CrossFit class, and has a coffee and co-working space for members who work remotely.
address: Barns Court, Crawley Down, West Sussex, RH10 4HQ

name: TrainRX
description: TrainRX is a coach-led gym in Eastbourne and the home of CrossFit Burne, offering CrossFit classes, small group training and one-to-one personal training. It is also a HYROX-affiliated gym with dedicated race preparation, and newcomers can book a free intro consultation to get started.
address: 46 Brampton Road, Eastbourne, East Sussex, BN22 9BN

name: CrossFit Tonbridge
description: CrossFit Tonbridge has run CrossFit classes in Tonbridge since 2010. It operates alongside its sister box, CrossFit TAG in Sevenoaks Weald, which follows the same programming, and memberships include access to both sites.
address: The Hayesbrook School, Brook Street, Tonbridge, Kent, TN9 2PH

name: CrossFit TAG
description: CrossFit TAG is the Sevenoaks Weald sister box of CrossFit Tonbridge, opened in 2020 and running the same CrossFit programming, with classes seven days a week. It also offers HYROX training, and one membership covers both the Sevenoaks and Tonbridge gyms.
address: Unit 19, Gaza Trading Estate, Scabharbour Road, Weald, Sevenoaks, Kent, TN11 8PL

name: CrossFit Crawley
description: CrossFit Crawley is based at Tilgate Forest Recreation Centre in Tilgate Park, running hour-long coached group CrossFit classes alongside open gym sessions. Newcomers can start with its Roots programme, and the gym focuses on building community and sustainable, healthy habits, with free trials and drop-ins available.
address: Hut 16, Tilgate Forest Recreation Centre, Crawley, West Sussex, RH10 5PQ

name: CrossFit Chimera
description: CrossFit Chimera runs daily CrossFit classes in Newhaven with scalable programming for all ages, from kids to members over 70. Alongside group classes it offers personal training and drop-ins, and the box has changing rooms with showers plus in-house physio and massage therapy.
address: Room 4, Unit 7, Harbour Enterprise Estate, Newhaven, East Sussex, BN9 9DG

name: Constant Pursuit CrossFit
description: Constant Pursuit CrossFit in Hastings runs up to seven coached classes a day for all fitness levels, each combining a weightlifting or gymnastics element with a high-intensity workout of the day. It also runs a Barbell Club for Olympic weightlifting, HYROX classes and Stretch & Recover sessions, with 24/7 open gym access for members.
address: 15 Burgess Road, Hastings, East Sussex, TN35 4NR

name: CrossFit Sevenoaks
description: CrossFit Sevenoaks is based in Dunton Green, close to the station and the M25, with free parking. It runs CrossFit and Barbell classes, a Foundations course for newcomers, and CrossFit Kids and Teens, and welcomes drop-ins.
address: Station Works, Rye Lane, Dunton Green, Sevenoaks, Kent, TN14 5HD

name: RH10 Fitness
description: RH10 Fitness is a functional fitness gym in Crawley running coached CrossFit classes designed to prepare members for life outside the gym. Its coaches all hold at least a CrossFit Level 2 qualification, and it also offers one-to-one personal training with individual programming.
address: 11 Royce Road, Crawley, West Sussex, RH10 9NX

name: Horsham CrossFit
description: Horsham CrossFit, run by Evolution Fitness at Tickfold Farm in Kingsfold, offers coached workout-of-the-day classes in small groups with scaled programming for all levels. The timetable also includes GAS endurance classes on bikes, rowers and ski ergs, HYROX classes, mobility sessions and a class for children.
address: Unit 1, Tickfold Farm, Marches Road, Kingsfold, Horsham, West Sussex, RH12 3SE

name: CrossFit Hunta
description: CrossFit Hunta is based at Mill Farm in Marden, near Tonbridge, running coached CrossFit classes alongside individually tailored programming. Sessions include Olympic lifting, gymnastics, a strength programme and a beginners' programme, with options from drop-ins to no-contract memberships, for both general fitness and competitive training.
address: Mill Farm, Marden, Kent, TN12 9QX

name: Built By Novo CrossFit
description: Built By Novo CrossFit is a functional fitness gym on Beeching Road in Bexhill-on-Sea, offering coached classes and open gym, with every workout scaled so members can work at their own pace. It began as Project Novo Fitness, a community-focused non-profit gym, and community is still at its heart.
address: Unit 12, Beeching Road, Bexhill-on-Sea, East Sussex, TN39 3LJ

name: CrossFit ChalkBox
description: CrossFit ChalkBox is a CrossFit and strength gym at Seal Chart near Sevenoaks, with coached classes for everyone from beginners to experienced athletes. Alongside CrossFit it runs CHALKFIT conditioning, a Barbell Club for Olympic weightlifting, personal training and kids' fitness, plus an outdoor rig and running track.
address: Chart Farm, Seal Chart, Sevenoaks, Kent, TN15 0ES

name: CrossFit 1066
description: CrossFit 1066 is based in the Old Observer Building in Hastings town centre, entered from Gotham Alley, running classes for everyone seven days a week. Its timetable mixes the workout of the day with conditioning, gymnastics and Olympic weightlifting classes, plus open lifting sessions.
address: Observer Building, Gotham Alley, Claremont, Hastings, East Sussex, TN34 1HA
